title: Measures and Frameworks to Ensure Telehealth Services are Appropriate and of Quality to Safeguard Patient Outcomes
what_it_is: Measures and Frameworks to Ensure Telehealth Services are Appropriate and of Quality to Safeguard Patient Outcomes

sections.label: Telemedicine licensing under HCSA
sections.summary: Telemedicine providers must be licensed under the Healthcare Services Act and comply with its requirements and standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Telemedicine providers are required to be licensed under the Healthcare Services Act, or HCSA, and comply with requirements and standards.

sections.label: MaNaDr licence revocation and SMC referrals
sections.summary: Doctors issued medical certificates against HCSA, MOH intends to revoke MaNaDr's outpatient licence, and some doctors are referred to SMC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The doctors were issuing medical certificates in a way that fell foul of HCSA and the Ministry of Health (MOH) had made known our intention for MaNaDr's outpatient medical service licence to be revoked.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Several doctors also appeared to have breached the SMC guidelines and are therefore referred to SMC for further disciplinary actions.

sections.label: Polyclinic caution on telemedicine MCs
sections.summary: Polyclinics were hesitant to allow telemedicine for acute treatment because of care over issuing medical certificates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: In the polyclinics, we were hesitant to allow telemedicine for acute treatment precisely because we want to be quite careful about the issuing of MCs.

sections.label: NHG Polyclinic telehealth for seniors
sections.summary: Work is being done with National Healthcare Group Polyclinic to have some seniors use telehealth instead of physical trips.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In fact, we are working with National Healthcare Group (NHG) Polyclinic to get some of my seniors to use telehealth services rather than make a physical trip to the polyclinic.

sections.label: MaNaDr appeal period and enforcement
sections.summary: MaNaDr has been notified its outpatient licence will be revoked, is still in the appeal period, and enforcement follows standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: MaNaDr has been notified that their outpatient licence will be revoked.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Now is still the period for them to appeal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: So, I think it is by good enforcement, following up on our standards, enforcing them, taking necessary actions, then we can fully utilise and leverage opportunities that new business models and technology can offer us.
